description: Use this when you need to check, before tendering a load or renewing a contract, whether a US motor carrier's operating authority is active and its insurance on file. For 1 to 10 USDOT numbers: authority per docket, BMC-91/34/84 filings, suspension notices and insurance cancellations with effective date and days left, next deadline. For carrier vetting. No personal data. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.
